_comment: 'Gain {r}{r}{r}' on a Lightning Instant. ability_type PLAY, not INSTANT - per DSL_REFERENCE, INSTANT means an ACTIVATED ability with instant timing, while an Instant CARD whose effect happens when you play it is PLAY. GAIN handler verified (effect_types.py:4869-4889): reads asset/amount, RESOURCE_POINTS routes through effect_gain_resources; player defaults SELF. No printed keywords, no additional costs, nothing left to the card DB.
